title: Broken Symmetry in LLM Refusal: Answer Release Is More Local Than Refusal Restoration
abstract: arXiv:2608.15772v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a language model refuses to answer a prompt, it is unclear whether the correct answer is erased from its internal representations, or merely suppressed at the output layer. We investigate this mechanism using a controlled withhold setting, which yields perfectly matched answering and refusal trajectories for bidirectional activation patching. We uncover a causal asymmetry in intervention locality under matched causal interventions, which we term broken symmetry. Even when a model generates a clean refusal, the correct answer remains linearly recoverable from its hidden states. Furthermore, releasing this withheld answer is a highly local operation, requiring only a single-position patch. Conversely, the reverse operation is not equally local: reimposing suppression requires broader interventions across multiple positions, and assembling a coherent refusal sequence is more difficult still. translated_title: 大语言模型拒绝机制中的对称性破缺：答案释放比拒绝恢复更具局部性
translated_abstract: 当语言模型拒绝回答提示时，尚不清楚正确答案是从其内部表示中被擦除，还是仅在输出层被抑制。我们通过一种受控的保留设置研究这一机制，该设置能在双向激活修补下产生完美匹配的回答和拒绝轨迹。我们发现了在匹配因果干预下干预局部性的一种因果不对称性，称之为对称性破缺。即使模型生成干净的拒绝，正确答案仍可从其隐藏状态中线性恢复。此外，释放这一被保留的答案是一个高度局部化的操作，仅需单位置修补。相反，反向操作并不同样局部：重新施加抑制需要在多个位置进行更广泛的干预，而组装连贯的拒绝序列则更为困难。我们进一步证明，虽然平均...
tldr: 本文发现大语言模型拒绝回答时正确答案仍可恢复，且释放答案仅需单点干预，而重新抑制则需多点干预，揭示对称性破缺现象。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that in LLMs, withheld answers remain recoverable and releasing them requires only a single-point intervention, while re-suppression needs multi-point interventions, demonstrating broken symmetry.
